prompts.text: /clear
Explore `/run-brief` and describe all options that can be passed when invoking a run to me

There seems to be issues with `RUN_STREAMS_WATCHER` in my latest feature brief, that is distracting agents from their goal. Check tmux win0 for watcher and da-* windows for other agents. Is this some…
Can you check up on the watcher again? Seems there may be more leaks
Write a summary on preservation chasing a failing gap scan test (read-only) for me to reference in a blog post: An hour and a half in, at $54.22. Preservation hasn't committed for 30 minutes because…
Summarize progress so far by work streams relative to the brief. Are we on the right track? How impactful are their results?

Should we address this prior to the stream finishing? <pasted_content id="034f"> 3. The lines are getting tangled. Streams merge each other's work before the watcher merges them into the default line…
Share a progress update
Analyze and summarize current state of preservation workspace
Summarize I010 for me in the context of the running preservation stream
Summarize overall progress in this stream
Would it help for the external expert to scope out / evaluate 307 more deeply prior to agents starting? I am concerned that there is a lot of complexity here and we may take the wrong path.
I've brought in a specialist agent in tmux4. Summarize what it is working now, and what the preservation agent is working on, then summarize how they relate or intersect.
I'll check with the watcher on that. Does our current framework support companion claims? Any examples?

I'm considering pausing the current run to implement a major new feature (see tmux 9, 3.5 brief) that would enable more complex problems to be solved more efficiently. Can you review the current stat…
Can you fix the challenge workspace? Consider how to do it, then prepare a message I will share with the watcher to execute -- this workspace seems really valuable to keep going
Can you amend an existing or create a new VF finding with what you have found here? We can action it later.
Review progress on the current run then summarize recent work and provide an overview of what's remaining along with a time estimate
Describe D023 for me
Keep it for now, we will explore more options post 3.5
Review (read-only) the current state of the run and estimate time remaining.
